crossRefs.note: “Go up on her walls, and destroy; but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.
“Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together…
Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their…
He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold…
Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of…
Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them…
Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas. I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a…
For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted…
“The harvest is past. The summer has ended, and we are not saved.”
Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains…

translations.web: “Prepare war against her! Arise! Let’s go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
translations.bsb: ‘Prepare for battle against her; rise up, let us attack at noon. Woe to us, for the daylight is fading; the evening shadows grow long.
translations.kjv: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
translations.asv: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day declineth, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
